subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding & Procurement - Ariba/Coupa Setup
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding & Procurement - Ariba/Coupa Setup

Thanks for the call earlier, Jordan — good to align. I promised to circulate a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the procurement/vendor onboarding milestone so your procurement team knows the steps we need to complete before we can go live on Dedicated capacity. Draft attached (Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx).

High level summary of the vendor onboarding milestone we discussed:
- Target close: Sept 17, 2026 (preferred) — allows us to complete PO + onboarding ahead of integration sprint.
- Key deliverables from Acme: completed vendor form (we attached our Redwood_Vendor_Form.pdf), signed W-9, banking details (ACH remit), Ariba or Coupa supplier setup confirmation.
- Key deliverables from Redwood: vendor profile completed in Ariba/Coupa, SOC2 evidence package sent, account engineer assigned for onboarding, invoice & tax paperwork on file.

Dependencies/risks:
- If Ariba/Coupa integration requires additional legal terms, that can add ~1-2 weeks.
- Banking (ACH) verification sometimes takes 3-5 business days; recommend starting that now.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
1) Jordan/Procurement: Confirm whether Acme will use Ariba or Coupa for vendor onboarding and share point-of-contact — target: 2026-08-24.
2) Procurement: Return completed vendor form + W-9 + banking details — target: 2026-08-31.
3) Camila (Redwood Ops): Prepare vendor profile and kick off supplier onboarding once we have the above — target: 2026-09-02.
4) Dev (Redwood Finance): Prepare invoice templates and confirm payment terms (NET30) — target: 2026-09-03.

Please review the attached MAP and let me know if you want any of the milestones adjusted. If procurement prefers a shorter timeline, we can try to compress steps but will need Ariba/Coupa confirmation ASAP.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx, Redwood_Vendor_Form.pdf

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>

Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@acme.com>, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@acme.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor Onboarding & Procurement - Ariba/Coupa Setup

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. This aligns with our internal expectations. A few quick notes from procurement: 

1) We use Coupa for supplier setup; I'll add our Coupa onboarding link below and loop in Lisa (procurement lead) to coordinate the form upload.
2) We can get the W-9 and vendor form back to you by 2026-08-28 if we prioritize it. Banking details can follow (we'll need our treasury team to sign off).
3) On Ariba vs Coupa: Confirmed — Coupa. Our Coupa admin will need the vendor tax ID and W-9 to complete the supplier record.

Action: Lisa, can you confirm internal POC and earliest date for upload?

Jordan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Financial
jordan.ellis@acme.com | (212) 555-4483

Hi all — looping in procurement ops. Quick responses to the action items: 

- Confirmed: we will use Coupa. Our Coupa admin is Mei Chen (mei.chen@acme.com) — Mei will perform the supplier creation once we have the W-9 + vendor tax ID + vendor form.
- Timeline: if Marissa/Redwood can accept W-9 + completed vendor form by EOD 2026-08-28, Mei can provision the supplier record on 2026-08-31. Banking (ACH) verification typically starts on provisioning and may take up to 5 business days.
- Dependencies: Legal has a standard SOW addendum for cloud vendors; if Redwood needs custom terms, that will require Legal review (1-2 week delta).

We have uploaded your vendor onboarding checklist link to our Coupa instance and will notify when the supplier record is active.

Lisa Monroe

lisa.monroe@acme.com | (212) 555-0921

Thanks, Lisa — this is perfect and very actionable. Quick confirmation of responsibility/next-steps and owners (I'll update the MAP and re-share):

- Acme (Lisa/Mei): Upload W-9 + completed Redwood_Vendor_Form.pdf to Coupa by 2026-08-28.
- Acme (Treasury): Provide banking details / ACH remit info at time of Coupa provisioning (target 2026-08-31).
- Redwood (Camila): Create supplier profile in Coupa/Ariba and notify Mei when provisioning is complete — target 2026-09-01. Camila will also start SOC2 evidence packet transfer once account is provisioned.
- Redwood (Dev/Finance): Confirm invoice template and NET30 terms; Dev will confirm payment instructions and invoice cadence by 2026-09-03.

I'll update the MAP file (Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx) to reflect Coupa-specific steps and push a finalized version by EOD 2026-08-21. If anyone needs the timeline tightened, flag it here and we can try to compress tasks.
